channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israel launches more than 10 strikes across southern Lebanon
item.description: Videos show the aftermath of renewed Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon that killed at least three people.

item.title: Damage seen in northern Israel after Hezbollah launches rocket barrages
item.description: Israel says it has intercepted an air attack from Hezbollah on Saturday, May 30th.

item.title: Ukraine drones strike Russian oil facility, as Kyiv and Moscow trade blows
item.description: Strikes have seen 13,000 residents without power in Zaporizhzhia as Russia and Ukraine trade drone attacks.

item.title: Iran war: What is happening on day 92 as Trump weighs Iran deal
item.description: Trump weighs next steps on Iran deal as Tehran insists negotiations are continuing and no final agreement exists.

item.title: Rwanda-Russia nuclear deal underscores Africa’s shifting power balance
item.description: Rwanda turns to Russia for nuclear training and research, advancing ambitions in technology, healthcare and diplomacy.

item.title: Iran war live: Supreme leader’s adviser blames US blockade for stalled deal
item.description: Israel issues three rounds of forced displacement orders for southern Lebanon towns as forces push deeper into country.

item.title: Trump pledges to withdraw from Kennedy Center after court strikes his name
item.description: Judge Christopher Cooper ruled against Trump's bid to add his name to the building and close the theatre for two years.

item.title: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
item.description: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

item.title: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
item.description: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.

item.title: Israel put on UN sexual violence in warzones blacklist for first time
item.description: Israel says it rejects allegations in a new report by the office of the UN secretary general.
